title: Inductive Learning of Concept Embeddings from Cross-Linguistic Colexification Patterns with Textual Attributes
abstract: arXiv:2610.22638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The advent of distributional semantics as a framework for computational semantics marked a paradigm shift in the nature of representations, by which meanings are represented as dense vectors commonly known as word embeddings. Computational approaches to historical or typological language comparison, on the other hand, still mostly rely on discrete representations, while the potential of embedding-based methods remains largely untapped in this context. Recent studies have proposed concept embeddings as a language-independent, onomasiological counterpart to word embeddings, based on networks of cross-linguistic colexification patterns. While the resulting concept embeddings reflect meaningful semantic properties and relations, they suffer from a lack of scalability, since they rely on transductive embedding approaches which only learn embeddings for nodes present in the training data. translated_title: 结合文本属性从跨语言共词化模式中归纳学习概念嵌入
translated_abstract: 分布语义学作为计算语义学框架的出现，标志着表示方式的范式转变，意义被表示为通常称为词向量的密集向量。另一方面，面向历史或类型学语言比较的计算方法仍大多依赖离散表示，基于嵌入的方法在这一领域的潜力在很大程度上尚未被开发。最近的研究基于跨语言共词化模式网络，提出了概念嵌入作为词向量的语言无关、以名为义的对应物。虽然由此产生的概念嵌入反映了有意义的语义属性和关系，但其可扩展性不足，因为它们依赖于直推式嵌入方法，只能为训练数据中存在的节点学习嵌入。在本研究中，我们提出了一个归纳式……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种结合文本属性的归纳式框架，从跨语言共词化模式中学习概念嵌入，克服了以往直推式嵌入方法无法为训练数据之外的新概念生成嵌入的可扩展性局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an inductive framework that learns concept embeddings from cross-linguistic colexification patterns enriched with textual attributes, overcoming the scalability limitations of transductive embedding approaches that only cover concepts seen in training data.
